Tile materials, finishes and installation locations

Our local tilers install porcelain and ceramic tiles on floors and walls, subway tiles on kitchen splashbacks, and ceramic or glass mosaic tiles in niches and feature areas. Large-format porcelain needs flatness, adhesive coverage and neighbouring tile edges planned together. For outdoor porcelain tiles, we coordinate the specified slip resistance, drainage falls and movement joints.

Australian product labels may use porcelain, vitrified or fully vitrified to describe the tile body. Polished describes a surface finish; glazed describes a glaze layer; full-body porcelain describes the body construction. A glazed porcelain tile can also have a polished finish. Glass mosaic is a different material, not another name for vitrified porcelain. Send the tile name, size and intended location so we can plan the installation around the actual product.
